quotes.text: Test the user-visible result, not an incidental mechanism. In D318396, IMAP move tests were rewritten to check the messages received by the server instead of inspecting offline-operation internals. The fixed delay and extra timeout factor then disappeared. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D318396 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/9bdc099e6cefe74155e2d7c9043c8c69
